title: Pharmacy Benefit Plan Accumulator Correction Standard
content:
**C1 — What a correction is.** A manual correction fixes a Pharmacy Benefit Plan deductible or out-of-pocket accumulator that does not equal what the claims of record support. It posts the difference as a credit or a reversal that references the ledger entry being corrected.

**C2 — Current plan year.** A correction for the current plan year may be posted at any time while the enrollment is not terminated.

**C3 — Prior plan year.** A correction for a prior plan year may be posted only within the design's prior-year correction window — a number of calendar days — after the last day of that plan year, counted with the last day as day zero. The last day of a prior plan year is the day before the enrollment's current plan year start date. The plan year of the entry, and the enrollment's current plan year start date, are read from the records; the last day of the window is itself within it.

**C4 — Evidence.** A correction is never posted from the member's statement alone; it requires a claim, feed or statement of record that the accumulator fails to reflect.

## C3 boundary cases (hypothetical enrollment whose current plan year began 1 January, in a year in which February has 28 days; window of 90 calendar days)

The prior plan year's last day is 31 December, the day before 1 January. Counting 31 December as day zero, 31 January is day 31, 28 February is day 59 and 31 March is day 90.

| Date a prior-year correction would be posted | Day count | Within the window |
|---|---|---|
| 15 January | Day 15 | Yes |
| 30 March | Day 89 | Yes |
| 31 March | Day 90, the last day of the window | Yes |
| 1 April | Day 91 | No |

## Judging a correction

| Plan year being corrected | Enrollment status | Posting date | Record the accumulator fails to reflect | Correction may be posted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Current | Not terminated | Any | Present | Yes |
| Current | Not terminated | Any | Member's statement only | No |
| Prior | — | Within the window | Present | Yes |
| Prior | — | After the window | Present | No |

A dash means C3 states no condition on the enrollment status.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A pharmacy claim of record for the current plan year should have posted 40.00 to out-of-pocket, but the out-of-pocket accumulator reflects 25.00 for it. The enrollment is active. A correction credit of 15.00, the difference, may be posted, referencing the ledger entry being corrected.
